SELECT
  metric_time__month
  , CAST(monthly_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(monthly_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('month', month_date) AS metric_time__month
      , member_id AS __monthly_buyer_count
      , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
    FROM "data"."main"."member_month_activity" member_month_activity_semantic_src_10000
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', month_date) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_6
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_8
answer: 2026年7月月内复购率为9.09%，8月为80.00%，8月较7月上升约70.91个百分点。口径为同一自然月的月内复购会员数除以月内购买会员数，按CRM会员账户统计，覆盖全门店完整自然月。该结果只能说明8月月内复购率高于7月，不能据此判断是“助手”提升了复购：当前没有助手使用/未使用分组、对照期或其他同期因素控制，无法进行因果归因。
